reason: The hypothesis makes several specific mechanistic claims about SRO in CoCrFeNiCu nanoparticles, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific binding energy, diffusion barrier, or premelting effects of SRO in this particular high-entropy alloy system.
